summary: One Secure Agility camera (counter 247) covering 11 zones at Oxford St / Queen St / Lang Rd, Paddington, with many whole-camera outages that are already missing. The main faults are about 100 zone-day episodes of phantom counts: bursts of hundreds of detections an hour, split near-evenly between IN and OUT, confined to one zone, often running overnight. They are worst on 278 (Queen St north footpath) and 275 in Sep-Dec 2023 and on 276, 282 and 285 in late Nov 2024, and are set missing. The June 2022 commissioning weeks read outside all later levels for 274/275/277/279 and are set missing. Zone levels also shift at camera restarts, most clearly Nov 2022-Apr 2023, which is recorded as uncertain. The site has one counter, so no series are defined.
